decisive_items: expansion of the right frontal sinus and right ethmoid sinus without any bone destruction
High signal on T2-weighted image and ring enhancement in the right frontal sinus
Mild inflammatory infiltrate with fibrosis, lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate, few eosinophils and no sign of malignancy
response.rationale: Chronic sinus expansion without bone destruction and ring enhancement on MRI are classic for frontal sinus mucocele; histopathology shows chronic inflammation without granulomas or malignancy. Chronic frontal sinusitis is less specific and lacks the expansile feature.

rejected.why: No granulomas described; histopathology is nonspecific chronic inflammation.
No vasculitis or granulomatous features; GPA would typically show systemic involvement.
Too broad; does not account for sinus expansion.
Orbital involvement explicitly excluded by imaging.
Location is eyelid/sinus, not lacrimal sac; imaging points to frontal sinus.
No sulfur granules or specific evidence; chronic discharge alone is nonspecific.
